7.6.3.6.1 Unavailability of receive buffer common for master and slave nodes
[SWS_LinIf_00676] ⌈If the function PduR_LinTpStartOfReception returns
BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK or BUFREQ_E_OVFL, the LIN Interface shall abort the reception
without any further calls to PduR.⌋
[SWS_LinIf_00701] ⌈If the function PduR_LinTpStartOfReception returns
BUFREQ_OK with a smaller available buffer size than needed for the data received
in the First Frame of a TP message (SF or FF), the LIN Interface shall abort the re-
ception and notify the upper layer by calling the function PduR_LinTpRxIndication
with result E_NOT_OK.⌋
